title: Why the next trillion dollar company will be built by one person

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What if the next trillion-dollar company isn’t built by a team — but one person using AI and blockchain?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Today, a single developer can create apps using AI coding tools and deploy them on global blockchains in minutes.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: But if one person controls a company worth a trillion dollars, how do we ensure transparency, fairness, and accountability?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Open-source AI frameworks and decentralized governance models are being built to let communities shape and monitor these systems.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Imagine a solo entrepreneur using AI to solve climate change — their impact could be massive, and their success truly global.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future may belong to the individual who can harness technology, ethics, and vision in perfect balance.

video_cue: A lone figure at a computer, surrounded by holographic data streams and AI-generated blueprints for a sustainable city.
